name: Mongbwalu

queries.query: Mongbwalu Democratic Republic of the Congo official cadastral map parcel land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official DRC Ministry of Land Affairs site, its national cadastral/land-registry service workflow, and an official list of land-registration districts. No city-specific anonymous parcel viewer, vector service, or public parcel geometry endpoint for Mongbwalu was identified.

queries.query: RDC Mongbwalu cadastre carte parcellaire registre foncier officiel
queries.result: French-language discovery found the official Ministry of Land Affairs and its French land-research procedure. The procedure requires a formal request and identity/property information; it does not expose an anonymous parcel map or safe ID-plus-geometry response. The official district list shows Ituri offices for Bunia, Aru, Mahagi, Djugu, Mambasa, and Irumu, but not a Mongbwalu-specific public service.

registryEvidence: The Ministry of Land Affairs is evidenced as the national custodian and publishes Ituri land-registration districts and a formal land-research procedure. This is national/provincial custody evidence, not evidence of a public Mongbwalu local registry or anonymous parcel geometry service.
uncertainty: Mongbwalu may have operational cadastral records under an Ituri/Djugu or other competent land-registration office that are not anonymously exposed online. No absence inference is made from the lack of a public viewer, from search misses, or from the fact that the formal workflow requests identity and property-reference data. The city point was not shifted and no exact-point parcel query was treated as a citywide test.
